# DAX information functions in Lumen

> **Applies to:** Analysts · Developers

Support status, in Lumen's DAX engine, of every function that Microsoft's DAX reference lists under **Information functions**: 36 implemented, 5 partial and 4 not implemented, out of 45.

| Function | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| COLUMNSTATISTICS | Not implemented |  |
| CONTAINS | Implemented |  |
| CONTAINSROW | Implemented |  |
| CONTAINSSTRING | Implemented |  |
| CONTAINSSTRINGEXACT | Implemented |  |
| CUSTOMDATA | Partial | Always blank (there is no connection string). |

| HASONEVALUE | Implemented |  |

| ISBLANK | Implemented |  |
| ISBOOLEAN | Implemented |  |

| USERCULTURE | Partial | Always returns en-US. |
| USERNAME | Partial | There is no signed-in user: returns LOCAL\user. |
| USEROBJECTID | Partial | There is no signed-in user: returns an all-zero GUID. |
| USERPRINCIPALNAME | Partial | There is no signed-in user: returns user@localhost. View as cannot simulate another user. |
